Stock market news | Zee Entertainment announces ₹600 crore buyback at ₹91 per share

On 25 November 2026 five Indian companies have corporate actions. Zee Entertainment announced a ₹600 crore share buyback at ₹91 per share. Vraj Iron and Steel declared a ₹0.60 interim dividend. Bonlon Industries, Indergiri Finance and Vellora Impact launched rights issues.
